title: Santa's Little Helper Toddler Long Sleeve Shirt, Kids Christmas Tee, Cute Elf Puppy Holiday Shirt, Christmas Gift for Kids
description:
Every elf needs a little helper! A cheerful puppy in a green elf hat carries a Christmas present across this cosy long-sleeve tee, with "SANTA'S LITTLE HELPER" in bold retro varsity letters.

Perfect for Christmas morning photos, holiday parties, cookie baking with grandma and family pictures by the tree. A sweet gift for nieces, nephews and grandkids.

DETAILS
- 100% combed ring-spun cotton fine jersey, soft and breathable
- Long sleeves, classic fit
- Sizes: 2T, 3T, 4T, 5-6T (please check the size chart in the photos)
- Front print

CARE
Machine wash cold, inside out. Do not tumble dry on high heat. Do not iron directly on the print.

PRODUCTION AND SHIPPING
Printed on demand by our production partner in the USA and shipped with tracking. Production takes 2-5 business days. This item ships to the USA and Canada.

Design created by MurettoStudio with the help of AI image tools, then checked and prepared for print by me.

Photos: the first photo is the product mockup from our print partner; the lifestyle photos are digital mockups created for illustration.
